description: This file defines the WidgetsListPartDisplayDriver class, which manages the display, editing, and updating of WidgetsListPart components within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles rendering widgets in layout zones, editing widget configurations, and processing updates to widget lists.

classes.name: WidgetsListPartDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver class for managing the display, editing, and updating of WidgetsListPart components within OrchardCore CMS.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Handles rendering widgets within layout zones if the display type is 'Detail' and there are widgets to display.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the editor shape for editing the WidgetsListPart, including available zones and current widget configuration.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to the WidgetsListPart, including creating new content items, merging existing ones, and updating widget zones.
